# AWS Student Builder Group RIU Sahiwal
> Student-run cloud computing community at Riphah International University, Sahiwal Campus (Sahiwal, Punjab, Pakistan). Also known as AWS SBG RIU Sahiwal, AWS Riphah Sahiwal and AWS Sahiwal.

## Key facts
- First session: "AWS Starting Point" on 18 November 2026, University Auditorium, RIU Sahiwal.
- Speaker and group leader: Muhammad Yousaf.
- Registration: Meetup event page (https://www.meetup.com/aws-sbg-at-riphah-international-university-sahiwal-campus/events/317359073/).
- Planned sessions: Introduction to Git and GitHub; Build with Kiro (dates to be announced).
- Sponsors: WakeelsApp (https://wakeels.app/), Super Crisp (https://supercrisp.com.pk/).
- Social: Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/riphah.sbg.swl), LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/aws-student-builder-group-riphah-sahiwal/).
